questions.title: Review date imputation against the analysis guide
questions.excerpt:
The three deaths reported during the conduct of this study are captured in the Results in Death 
Flag (AESDTH=’Y’) and Outcome of Adverse Event (AEOUT=’FATAL’).  The Start Date of 
the Adverse Event in ADAE is imputed to the first of the month if the day is missing. The Study 
Day of Event Start (ASTDY) and the Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag (TRTEMFL) are 
derived based on this imputation and may differ from their corresponding SDTM AE/SUPPAE 
variables Study Day of Start of Adverse Event (AESTDY) and Treatment Emergent Flag 
(AETRTEM).
questions.guidance: Compare the quoted rule with the ASTDT specification, partial source dates and derived dates. Record your interpretation in a comment.

questions.title: Review the ordinary NPI baseline-flag window
questions.excerpt:
Label: Analysis Baseline Flag
Data type: text
Origin: Derived
questions.guidance: Original ItemDefs ADQSNPIX.ABLFL.NPITM01S and .NPTOT (define-adam.xml comments at lines 14220 and 14340) specify QS.QSBLFL. Native SDTM QS.QSBLFL (define-sdtm.xml line 3856) uses collected VISIT=BASELINE; QSDY is calculated relative to first treatment, and the retained definitions do not guarantee QSDY<=1 for every collected baseline visit. Compare with yamaa/adqsnipx.yaml natural at line 2336, which additionally requires _WINDOW=0 (QSDY<=1 at lines 2260-2261). Determine whether ordinary flags should copy QSBLFL directly or apply the extra window restriction. SAP page-11 explains an analysis baseline window without expressly amending the native flag-copy instruction. The projected excerpt is verified; the independent adjudicator manually checked these native pointers outside exported quoted-rule coverage. No affected-record count has been established.
